title: PixelForge run manifest
description: Describes one batch bake: the sheets written, the animation layout needed to read them, and the skin ramps they were recoloured into. This file is the shipped contract — consumers read it, PixelForge only writes it.

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema copied beside this manifest, so an editor validates it with no network access.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this manifest format. The major component changes only on a breaking change to the shape.

runId.description: UUIDv7 identifying the bake run. Leads with a millisecond timestamp, so run ids sort chronologically.

sheets.description: Every sheet the run wrote, in bake order.

hexColor.description: Opaque RGB colour, uppercase hex. Alpha is never carried — the recolour only ever substitutes opaque pixels.

facing.description: Direction the avatar faces. Curated sheets drop north entirely.

name.description: Identity of the ramp. Names are unique case-insensitively; a custom ramp may not shadow a built-in.

isHuman.description: Whether this reads as human skin. Fantasy tones are reachable only by explicit choice, never by a hashed default.

steps.description: The five ramp steps, darkest shadow first. Index 3 is the base tone — what a viewer thinks of as 'the' colour of this ramp.

palette.description: The colours behind the run. A recolour is a straight index-for-index substitution of five colours — no blending, no dithering, no colour-space maths.

sourceRamp.description: The ramp every source partial is authored in, and therefore what each sheet's tone was substituted FROM.

ramps.description: The distinct tones this run actually substituted INTO, including any custom ramps. A run that applied no tone carries an empty array.

frameCount.description: Frames in this clip. They occupy output columns 0 to frameCount-1 of the clip's row; trailing cells up to the sheet's column count are transparent.

sourceColumn.description: Provenance only: the column of frame 0 in the 23-column source sheet. NOT an output column — curated frames are always left-aligned from column 0.

rows.description: Output row this clip occupies for each facing, stated per facing so a consumer never has to know the row formula.

columns.description: Source columns to draw, in playback order. This repeats and descends — walk is 1, 2, 1, 0 — so it MUST NOT be re-sorted or de-duplicated.

isRenderedByDefault.description: Whether the generator treats this clip as a playable animation rather than a single pose.

reverseDrawOrder.description: Whether this clip's layers composite back to front. True for climb alone.

curatedLayout.description: The curated sheet: 8 clips on 3 facings, north dropped, frames left-aligned per row.

columns.description: Columns in the sheet, set by the widest clip.

rows.description: Rows in the sheet: one per clip per facing.

frameDurationMs.description: How long each frame is held. The deliberate cadence of this art style — play at this rate rather than guessing.

facings.description: Facings this geometry carries, in row order within a clip.

fullLayout.description: The raw source assembly, written without a remap: all source columns on all four facing rows.

facingRows.description: Sheet row each facing occupies. Fixed for every clip in this geometry, which is why it sits on the layout rather than on each clip.

layouts.description: A layout appears only when the run actually produced that geometry, so a manifest never describes files that are not in the folder.

slots.description: The partial that filled each layer slot, back to front, by stem. A slot the sheet does not use is absent rather than empty.

file.description: The file written, including extension. Lossless WebP, verified by round trip.

geometry.description: Which layout under layouts describes this sheet.

tone.description: Name of the ramp under palette.ramps this sheet's skin was substituted into. Absent when the sheet carries no skin and keeps its authored colours.
